name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: 0.0.30 stopped new federated items from being created with IsShortcut/ShortcutPath set (which broke playback - see 0.0.30's changelog), but reconciliation only ever creates and deletes items, never updates them in place, so every item already persisted under 0.0.26-0.0.29 kept the stale IsShortcut=true and kept crashing on every playback attempt exactly as before - confirmed directly in a user-supplied log taken after upgrading to 0.0.30. This release adds the missing one-time migration: every existing federated item is rebuilt once more so the stale flag is actually cleared. Local watch progress on federated items is reset, as with prior rebuilds.
